purpose: Falsify the assumption that an official correlation-table mapping implies proposition-level continuity. Directive 2008/90/EC Annex III explicitly labels several mapped successors as amended.

official_evidence.observation: The authentic act's correlation table maps predecessor provisions to successors while explicitly marking multiple successors 'amended'. Examples include Article 1(3) -> Article 18 amended; Article 3(c)-(f) -> Article 2(5)-(8) amended; Article 4(1) -> Article 4 amended; Article 11 -> Article 9 amended; Article 13 -> Article 11 amended.
The official proposal distinguishes inherited/adapted text from material explicitly marked 'new', demonstrating that the successor text was not merely renumbered wholesale.

adversarial_claim: An official correlation-table edge is direct structural-lineage evidence even where the official table itself signals substantive amendment. It is therefore unsafe to infer RULE_CONTINUES from correlation alone.
forbidden_inference: Do not emit RULE_CONTINUES, RULE_NARROWS, RULE_EXPANDS, or conceptual-successor semantics solely from these structural mappings. Proposition-level comparison requires separately anchored authentic-text evidence.
architecture_result: Structural lineage and semantic rule lineage remain separate graphs/claims. Official qualifiers attached to correlation entries must be retained as evidence rather than normalized away.
